name: Market Watchtower｜市場條件監控與決策提醒系統
description: 可擴充的市場條件監控、資料健康檢查與決策提醒系統，第一個 use case 為 0050/006208 進場條件提醒。
goals: 建立可追溯資料來源的市場資料抓取與正規化流程，第一版支援 0050、006208、2330 與台股指數類資料。
建立可重複計算的條件規則引擎，輸出 CLEAR / WATCH / TRIGGERED / INVALIDATED / DATA_DELAYED 狀態。
建立 Market Watchtower 自有 runtime dashboard，用於查看資產狀態、資料健康、訊號與通知紀錄。
建立雲端排程與通知機制，讓電腦未開機時仍能在條件接近或觸發時收到提醒。
保留未來擴充到 ETF、個股、基金、匯率、債券與月配型基金資料驗證的架構。

risks.risk: 資料來源延遲或欄位格式變動導致錯誤提醒
risks.mitigation: 每筆訊號必須帶 source_date / fetched_at；資料未更新時輸出 DATA_DELAYED，不發進場提醒。

risks.risk: 提醒被誤解為自動買賣建議
risks.mitigation: 所有通知與 dashboard 文案都標示 decision prompt，不輸出買入/賣出命令。

risks.risk: 規則太多造成通知噪音
risks.mitigation: 以 alert_states 去重，只在狀態改變時通知；第一版只啟用 200MA、20/60MA 回測與突破回測。

risks.risk: Dashboard 與 MC 邊界混淆
risks.mitigation: MC 只追蹤 project/tasks；Market Watchtower Dashboard 承擔 runtime truth。

decisions.decision: Use market-watchtower / Market Watchtower as the reusable project name.
decisions.reason: The system is not limited to Taiwan or ETFs; it monitors market conditions across assets and data sources.
alternatives_rejected: taiwan-etf-watchtower: too narrow for future funds, FX, bonds, and overseas ETFs
TW50 Signal: sounds like a trading-signal product rather than a monitoring system

decisions.decision: Market Watchtower must own its own runtime dashboard.
decisions.reason: Daily usage requires asset state, data freshness, signal history, and notification logs; MC is only project/task control plane.
alternatives_rejected: Use MC as dashboard: mixes development tracking with runtime market state
Notification only: lacks auditability and data-health visibility

decisions.decision: Start with 0050/006208 entry-condition alerts while keeping the data model asset-agnostic.
decisions.reason: A narrow first case validates price data, indicators, rules, de-duplication, notifications, and dashboard without locking the architecture to ETFs.
alternatives_rejected: Start with all asset classes: too broad before data correctness is proven
Start with only monthly funds: data-source quality is harder and should come after the runtime loop works

decisions.decision: Track as standalone project with local workspace first; GitHub repo and Zeabur/VPS deployment are later execution tasks.
decisions.reason: The workspace already exists and contains project documents; forcing new-project standalone auto-clone would risk clobbering the existing folder.
alternatives_rejected: Run standalone auto repo creation immediately: unsafe with pre-existing local folder
Keep as pure internal project: inaccurate because the product will have independent code and deployment

system_growth_gate.trigger: Daily cloud worker after market close, plus manual dashboard review when Vincent wants to inspect market conditions.
system_growth_gate.data_flow: market data sources -> normalized price/valuation records -> indicators -> rule states -> alert events -> notification + dashboard
system_growth_gate.visible_surface: Market Watchtower Dashboard for runtime; harness-mc for project/task tracking.
system_growth_gate.feedback_loop: Alert outcomes and data-health failures are logged, reviewed, and used to refine rules, thresholds, and data-source adapters.

hc_decision.hc_reasoning: The project was reframed from an ETF entry alert into a market-condition monitoring system with data correctness, runtime visibility, and notification de-duplication as first-class concerns.
hc_decision.source_boundary: HC is the thinking and validation layer; project files and harness-mc tasks are the execution source of truth.
